intro: Lesson 53. A teacher-written practice task in the style of Paper 2. Plan first (15 minutes), then code in Python, saving often.

passage.title: The task
paras: The masjid library lends books to members. Write a program that:
1. Loads a list of books (title, author, available: True or False) into a list of lists.
2. Shows a menu: 1 search by title, 2 borrow a book, 3 return a book, 4 list available books, 5 quit.
3. Search: asks for part of a title and shows every matching book (not case sensitive).
4. Borrow: asks for an exact title; if it is available, marks it as not available and confirms; otherwise shows a clear message.
5. Return: marks the book as available again, with validation if the title is not found.
6. Uses at least two subprograms with parameters and a return value, meaningful names and comments.

head: Test
Type
Input
Expected
rows: Confirmed; list now empty of it

blocks.answers: Mark points: list of lists loaded; menu loop until 5; case-insensitive search with 'in' and lower(); borrow and return update the available flag with validation; at least two subprograms with parameters and a return value; meaningful names and comments; tests show expected results.
